verdict.rationale: Zapier's core product is the Zap: a trigger-action workflow across 9,000+ apps. Its docs cover triggers (webhooks, polling triggers) and actions, and community users describe running multi-step IF/THEN Zaps. Community posts also report thin escape hatches for custom conditional logic in complex cases. Missing for 10: first-party end-user docs on defining event-triggered rules in the Zap editor, documented conditional/filter logic depth, and AI-native rule authoring evidence (e.g., natural-language Zap creation).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
